citations.title: Telefonica Brasil Q2 2026 Revenue Rises 7.6% to R$15.8 bn as Vivo Expands Mobile, Fiber, Digital Services and 5G - TelecomLead

sentences.text: Telefonica Brasil, which operates in Brazil under the Vivo brand, grows mobile service revenue through postpaid upselling, with postpaid accesses up 7.3 percent year over year to 52.4 million and mobile ARPU at a record BRL 32.5 with postpaid churn near 1 percent.

sentences.quote: FTTH revenue grew 10.7 percent, while the company's fiber network expanded to 32.0 million homes passed, an increase of 6.4 percent. Connected fiber customers reached 8.2 million, growing 11.3 percent, lifting fiber take-up to 25.6 percent.
sentences.text: Fiber is a second engine: FTTH revenue rose 10.7 percent, homes passed reached 32.0 million and connected customers 8.2 million, lifting take-up to 25.6 percent.
Convergence lowers churn, as Vivo Total penetration reached about 45 percent of the fiber base.
Adjacent businesses diversify revenue, with new businesses in electronics, health, streaming and financial services growing 33.6 percent.
Capital returns are explicit: a buyback of up to R$1.0 billion through February 2027 and a commitment to distribute at least 100 percent of FY2026 net income, supported by net debt to EBITDA of 0.4x.
